candidates.overview: Our heroes have escaped the ever-changing jungles of Jumanji before, but this time the game comes to us - as Jumanji breaks free of its console, unleashing its chaos into our world.

candidates.title: Mr. Irrelevant
candidates.overview: The last player selected in the 1983 NFL draft by the New York Giants, underdog John Tuggle defies expectations on and off the field for head coach Bill Parcells, his newfound love, and his team, proving that remarkable hope and perseverance can transcend even the greatest challenges.

candidates.title: Our House
candidates.overview: Charls Carroll stars as a Revolutionary War soldier washed ashore from the past and resurrected.

candidates.title: The Pools
candidates.overview: A teenager trapped inside a seemingly endless aquatic labyrinth of swimming pools, towering waterslides, flooded corridors, and impossible architecture. As he ventures deeper into the surreal liminal maze and reality itself begins to unravel, a mysterious creature stalks him from beneath the water, forcing him to find a way out before he disappears forever.

candidates.title: Werwulf
candidates.overview: A harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

candidates.title: wyrdo
candidates.overview: A Christmas dinner party is interrupted by an uninvited guest.

candidates.title: Apophis 2029
candidates.overview: On April 13, 2029, the asteroid Apophis will pass close enough to Earth, it will be below our satellites. It will dip below and pop back out.

candidates.title: Narayan Pustika 2 - Endless
candidates.overview: This movie is the second part of the Narayana Pustika trilogy. In which there is a description of the troubles arising from the opening of the unimaginable door revealed by the great sages.

candidates.title: 3xHelô
candidates.overview: A girl just broke up with her boyfriend and needs to talk.

candidates.title: Limerence
candidates.overview: Nora is an eccentric young woman with a debilitating infatuation with her newspaper delivery man — a man she has never even dared to speak to... Things begin to change when one fateful night, he appears to her in a dreamlike vision where he promises her everything she has ever longed for. Convinced this is her chance at true love, Nora decides to take a leap of faith in pursuit of her prince charming’s undivided affection.

candidates.title: The Selling Stage
candidates.overview: At the end of a twenty-five-year career, LuFisto confronts the cost of chasing a dream that asked for everything and gave back less than promised.

candidates.title: Untitled Coming of Age Film
candidates.overview: Plot unknown.

candidates.title: Bleeders
candidates.overview: A drug deal with a vampire goes horribly wrong.

candidates.title: Brujo
candidates.overview: Plot unknown.

candidates.title: Honeymoon
candidates.overview: When two strangers meet at a seemingly ordinary event, their lives could change forever; stepping into a fairytale romance, with the fragility of their blind love looming above them.

candidates.title: Mr. Penguin: The Movie
candidates.overview: When unexplained events begin to occur, a hidden presence reveals itself. Silent, watchful, and growing closer—Mr. Penguin is no longer just a mystery.

candidates.title: Pendulum
candidates.overview: A couple, journeys to a retreat in New Mexico seeking healing. Patrick grows skeptical of the retreat's leader as Abigail falls under her influence. They wonder if the group's practices offer genuine healing or conceal a terrifying truth.

candidates.title: Rocky Wake
candidates.overview: Elise, long estranged from her mother Megan, visits her as she lies on her deathbed. Her mother recounts a life-changing moment from the early 80s, her father’s devastating diagnosis and a serial killer stalking the town. Elise reconstructs her mother’s memories, drawing them closer as the night unfolds.

candidates.title: Starlight & You
candidates.overview: Lily and Peter is a modern romantic drama about timing, connection, and love tested by real life. When a quiet online connection pulls two people together, distance, delay, and unexpected loss challenge what they're building. As they choose to show up for one another, their bond deepens into a love shaped by family values, resilience, and emotional truth. Warm, intimate, and universally relatable, Lily and Peter is a character-driven love story made for audiences who believe the strongest romances are earned.

candidates.title: What We Owe to Each Other
candidates.original_title: What We Owe to Each Other
candidates.overview: Plot unknown.
